messages:
alexa: taking over primary for the next 2h — quick heads up: I see elevated 5xxs and user login failures (started ~2m ago). I'm on it but will need help. incident-bot created INC-2026-1234

incident-bot: ALERT: P0 detected (5xx spike). 5xx rate: 12% over baseline. Affected services: auth, session-store. Trigger: high-5xx-rate-rule.

mike: on it, I'm secondary. can you paste the first error snippet? any customer-facing pages?

alexa: customer-impact: ~8 users reported via support. rolling 500s from gateway to auth. logs showing `connection refused` to pg-pool-01. linking runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/db-connection-failures

sasha: if pg pool is flaky, try draining and restarting the pool instance before failover. runbook says: TTL 0 restart -> monitor.

alexa: doing a graceful drain on pg-pool-01 now. command: ```ssh ops@pg-01 'sudo systemctl stop redwood-pg-pool && sleep 5 && sudo systemctl start redwood-pg-pool'``` will post status in 30s

jordan: paging rules reminder: for P0, always page primary by phone + Slack. if no ack in 3m, page secondary. if no ack in 10m escalate to eng-sre-lead (pager), 20m escalate to product-oncall + customer-success. phone escalation only for P0.

priya: adding two quick notes: 1) if mitigation requires DB failover, get eng-sre-lead on call before failover. 2) annotate incident with customer IDs impacted.

alexa: pg restart started, initial health checks failing -> still errors. I'm going to open a Zoom bridge: zoom.us/j/987654321 (pin 1234). mike can you join and collect `pg_stat_activity` and pool logs?

mike: joining. grabbing logs now. tail command: ```sudo journalctl -u redwood-pg-pool -f --since "5 minutes ago" | sed -n '1,200p'```

mike: seeing repeated `FATAL: remaining connection slots are reserved for non-replication superuser connections`. pool config looks saturated. probable leak or long-running txs.

sasha: quick fix path: increase pool max temporarily + clear idle sessions. runbook snippet: `pg_ctl reload` then `SELECT pg_terminate_backend(pid) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state = 'idle' AND now()-state_change > interval '5 minutes';`

alexa: executed terminate query, increased pool max by +20. Monitoring errors...

incident-bot: UPDATE: P0 status: mitigation in progress. Alert suppressed for 10m while handlers run.

jordan: for future handoffs: please put primary/secondary in the handoff message, expected coverage window, and any current mitigation steps. e.g., `Primary: alexa (now->14:00 UTC); Secondary: mike; Current: draining pg-01, increasing pool`. Makes phone paging straightforward.

oncall-manager: noted. also add customer-impact estimate (count of affected users/orgs) and whether the incident triggers SLA notification thresholds (> 5% of requests or > 10 users).

alexa: postmortem note: I'll open a short incident doc and include timeline + decisions. tagging priya for CS outreach if we need to notify customers. thanks team — mike, sasha, can you stay on for the next 20m while I step out?

mike: staying on. will escalate to eng-sre-lead if we see errors persist after 10m.

sasha: monitoring dashboards -> error rate dropping to 3%, auth latency back to normal for 90% of requests. if stable for 15m we can close P0 to P1 and then to resolved.

alexa: good recovery. leaving primary to mike (temp). will record handoff in rota. :thumbsup:

mike: acknowledged. final note on paging: phone numbers are the canonical fallback. Slack follows but assume phone if P0. set escalation counters in incident bot if no ack.

alexa: thanks all. finishing incident doc and will include runbook tweaks (pool sizing alert earlier).

priya: filing a CS notification draft for affected users, will wait for final count from alexa.

incident-bot: INCIDENT INC-2026-1234 marked MITIGATING -> MONITORING. Next automated check in 10m.
